<section_guide number="1" title="What to Build">
<purpose>Decide the minimum PoC through one Primary Persona, one problem, a clear intent, and an observable success condition.</purpose>

<questions>
1. If several personas are possible, which single persona is most important, and what concrete problem are they facing?
2. What is the minimum PoC they must be able to use, and what visible result would make it successful?
</questions>

<workflow>
When several personas are presented, briefly name the candidates and ask the user to choose exactly
one Primary Persona before drafting or saving. Do not choose silently or combine candidates.

Use the project name as the document name. Draft only the problem, PoC intent, minimum user-visible
build scope, and observable success condition. Include permissions, privacy, safety, limits, or
failure guarantees only when the PoC itself must preserve them. Do not introduce Feature IDs,
technical choices, or a future implementation plan.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm one Primary Persona and the complete minimum PoC scope before saving 1.1-1.5 separately.</completion>
</section_guide>
